title: Ferrovial selected to deliver Georgia’s I-285 East Express Lanes
summary: Sala de prensa Ferrovial | Últimas noticias
body_markdown:
**[Ferrovial](https://www.ferrovial.com/en/)** , a leading global infrastructure company, announces that the Ferrovial-led consortium, Top End Mobility Group, has been **selected to deliver the I-285 East Express Lanes** project in Greater Atlanta, Georgia, a major **public-private partnership** led by the Georgia Department of Transportation ( **[GDOT](https://www.bing.com/ck/a?!&&p=c2c0b71fd21a0d56d68850e1edb081302ec991b066bdcad03b4392dfbf18bd26JmltdHM9MTc5MjAyMjQwMA&ptn=3&ver=2&hsh=4&fclid=19efb67b-80ce-6dab-36d3-a19281966ccf&u=a1aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmluZy5jb20vYWxpbmsvbGluaz91cmw9aHR0cCUzYSUyZiUyZnd3dy5kb3QuZ2EuZ292JTJmJnNvdXJjZT1zZXJwLWxvY2FsJmg9eXJwcGtTYzltWWNleFl5NG5oVlBoOG55NUVxbzBTUzU1RzE1eTl1Y0IxRSUzZCZwPWx3X21hZ3NtbHQmaWc9QTMwOEM4Mzk0RjZGNDY0RkE5NkNGNzEzMTBGN0Y0MEYmeXBpZD1ZTjc0RDkxQUUwMUMzQkVGMDg&ntb=1)** ) and the State Road and Tollway Authority, with an expected construction value of $8.9 billion.


“The I-285 East Express Lanes marks our **first managed lanes project in Georgia** , and an important milestone for Ferrovial in a state where we have been present for over a decade,” said Ignacio Madridejos, Ferrovial CEO. “Together with our construction projects across the region, it demonstrates our ability to deliver **complex, large-scale infrastructur** e that is essential to **improving mobility** and **supporting economic growth in the region** . We look forward to working alongside our public and private partners to deliver this project, seeking to **enhance connectivity and create long-term value across Greater Atlanta** .”


The Georgia Department of Transportation (GDOT) selected the Ferrovial-led consortium, which includes Tikehau Star Infra, to **finance, design, build, operate, and maintain Phase 1 of the I-285 East Express Lanes** project under a long-term agreement. Phase 1 includes approximately **21 miles of new express lanes** and key connections among I-285, I-85 and SR 400. The project will expand travel choices, helping provide more **reliable trip times** and connect with Georgia’s growing regional express-lane network.


Additionally, through a separate comprehensive development agreement, GDOT will collaborate exclusively with Top End Mobility Group to **advance the delivery of the remaining phases** of the I-285 East Express Lanes. Once all phases are complete, the project would provide approximately **37.5 miles of new express lanes in each direction** , connecting major business, employment and residential centers across Fulton and DeKalb counties.


Ferrovial has **successfully delivered and operated express lanes in other growing U.S. metropolitan areas** , including Dallas-Fort Worth, Charlotte and Washington, D.C. By bringing that experience to Georgia, the project will deliver lasting mobility benefits and support continued growth across Greater Atlanta.
